title: Sources and origin of data
html:
Checked out 2026-10-30.

  1. E1e, run 20261030-150813-643fdd30: bottom line, MIXED_EQUATIONS.json (5566 records, SMALL_UPPER_SETS.csv, four-saved matrix.bin/layout.json/native.json, list 173 unknown targets 101 It's a public dot SHA-256 and the starting paths, in manifest.json E1f. Copies of selected documents - in inputs/.
  2. E6H, run 20261030-122003-bb9bb8: CONCLUSION.md, REPORT.md, comparison.csv, README and toy.py. A known negative result of the joint chaincode-MITM It is accepted as the original; its chains and tests have not been repeated.
  3. Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone, Handbook of Applied Cryptography, Chapter 3, §3.6.2, Algorithm 3.56, print page. 105. Primary educational source for baseline baby-step giant-step and its procedures/The interval version is used after subtracting the known lower bound from the point.

Disaggregation by character, proof of rank, boundaries across particular characters, enumeration of direct abbreviations and conclusions about specific E1e-Branches are the own calculations of this experiment; they are not attributed to the source BSGS. External claims about the impossibility of extracting bits ECDLP Proven lower bounds for arbitrary algorithms are not used.
